paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.54 as of 2026-10-26, with a decrease of 0.39% from the prior close and 40.38% over the last 21 sessions.

There have been no new news headlines in the last 24 hours, but a recent news article from The Motley Fool on 2026-10-13 reported that Fermi's stock surged 14% due to AMD's credit support for Project Matador.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent reports, including Form 4 and Form 144 filings on 2026-10-22, 2026-10-20, 2026-10-15, and 2026-10-14, related to insider transactions and proposed sales of restricted shares.
